title: i18n(pages): a locale bundle with a page label but no title silently replaces the authored page:header title, including a dynamic '{name}', with the static label
body:
Filing gate: **① class (c): a trap that makes metadata an author wrote silently not take effect.** reach: the console record page header and `GET /api/v1/meta/page/:name`, measured on `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0 by the dev of objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2042 (PR objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2045). Named producer: `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`, `translatePage`.

**Who acts on it:** the objectstack triage seat routes it. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat, `session_018Mk4tab2eCyY41UTWK7y7V`. ⛔ Not a claim. hotcrm needs nothing from it: it now writes `title` in every pack, which the declared contract asks for.

## What happens

`translatePage` computes the header title as the bundle's page `title`, falling back to the bundle's page `label` (`i18n-resolver.ts:2288` on `main` `35ef501e13`):

```
const headerTitle = lookupPageAttr(bundle, name, 'title', opts)
  ?? lookupPageAttr(bundle, name, 'label', opts);
```

and then spreads it over the authored `page:header` `properties.title` (`:2361`), at a region root and a slot root alike. So a locale bundle that carries a page `label` but no `title` replaces ANY authored header title, including a dynamic one such as `'{name}'`, with the static page label. Nothing warns at build, lint or serve.

## Measured (17.7.0)

- hotcrm's `account_detail_page` authors a slotted header with `title: '{name}'`. Its zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES packs carried `title: '{name}'`; its en pack carried only `label: 'Account Detail'`.
- `GET /api/v1/meta/page/account_detail_page` served `slots.header.properties.title` = `'Account Detail'` in en and `'{name}'` in zh-CN and ja-JP, while `dist/objectstack.json` carried `'{name}'`.
- In the console as admin, every account record page `h1` read "Account Detail" in en. **Control:** lead and opportunity record pages showed the record name.

## Why it is a trap

The header title is the one page attribute an author usually makes dynamic (`'{name}'`), and the page label the one a translator always fills. A pack that translates the label and omits the title (the natural partial translation) turns every record's header into the page's static name in that locale, with no diagnostic. The fallback is declared ("title falls back to label when omitted"), so hotcrm satisfied it by writing `title` everywhere; whether the fallback should prefer the AUTHORED title over the bundle label, or the build should refuse a bundle that would replace a dynamic title, is the platform's to decide (hotcrm AGENTS.md §4: a bad platform default is fixed at the default).

## Duplicate check

Semantic issue search (MCP; this container's REST `/search` is refused) in objectstack: "translatePage page header title falls back to label replaces authored title locale bundle" → #7702 (closed, `PageHeaderProps.title` required vs the default header) and #3589 (closed, system pages' header i18n); "i18n resolver pages title missing in translation bundle silently overrides page:header title with label" → 0. Neither is this defect.
